name: basic_articles.txt
title: Basic German Articles
description: Practice definite and indefinite articles

name: verb_conjugation_regular.txt
title: Regular Verb Conjugation
description: Conjugate common regular verbs in the present tense (spielen, machen, lernen, wohnen).

name: verb_conjugation_irregular.txt
title: Irregular Verb Conjugation
description: Practice irregular verbs like sein, haben, gehen, sprechen, essen.

name: verb_modal_verbs.txt
title: Modal Verbs
description: Practice modal verbs (können, müssen, wollen, dürfen, sollen, mögen) in sentences.

name: verb_separable.txt
title: Separable Verbs
description: Form sentences with separable verbs (aufstehen, einkaufen, fernsehen).

name: cases_nominative.txt
title: Nominative Case
description: Identify subjects and choose the correct article in nominative.

name: cases_accusative.txt
title: Accusative Case
description: Practice direct objects and articles in accusative.

name: cases_dative.txt
title: Dative Case
description: Practice indirect objects and dative articles.

name: prepositions_accusative.txt
title: Prepositions with Accusative
description: Use prepositions like durch, für, gegen, ohne, um with correct articles.

name: prepositions_dative.txt
title: Prepositions with Dative
description: Use prepositions like aus, bei, mit, nach, seit, von, zu with correct articles.

name: prepositions_wechsel.txt
title: Two-Way Prepositions
description: Choose between accusative (movement) and dative (location) with an, auf, in, über, unter, vor, zwischen, hinter, neben.

name: articles_definite_indefinite.txt
title: Articles Practice
description: Choose between der/die/das, ein/eine in nominative and accusative.

name: articles_possessive.txt
title: Possessive Articles
description: Practice mein, dein, sein, ihr, unser, euer in sentences.

name: adjective_endings_easy.txt
title: Adjective Endings (Basics)
description: Practice adjective endings in nominative with definite/indefinite articles.

name: adjective_endings_full.txt
title: Adjective Endings (Full Declension)
description: Practice adjective endings across nominative, accusative, dative.

name: word_order_statements.txt
title: Word Order in Statements
description: Practice placing verbs in the second position.

name: word_order_questions.txt
title: Word Order in Questions
description: Form yes/no and W-questions correctly.

name: negation_nicht.txt
title: Negation with 'nicht'
description: Practice sentence negation using 'nicht' correctly.

name: negation_keine.txt
title: Negation with 'kein'
description: Practice negating nouns with 'kein/keine'.

name: plurals.txt
title: Plural Forms
description: Practice plural forms of common nouns.

name: time_expressions.txt
title: Time Expressions
description: Practice days, months, telling the time, and frequency adverbs.

name: comparatives.txt
title: Comparatives and Superlatives
description: Form and use adjectives in comparative and superlative forms.

name: reflexive_verbs.txt
title: Reflexive Verbs
description: Practice verbs with reflexive pronouns (sich freuen, sich waschen, sich erinnern).

name: relative_pronouns.txt
title: Relative Pronouns
description: Form simple relative clauses with der/die/das.
